biggest_catch: Only people with Type 1 or Type 2 diabetes qualify, and you must wear the CGM device for a full month and attend follow-up appointments in person in Mesquite, TX — the $1,000 is tied to full trial participation.
catches: Not everyone qualifies: you must have Type 1 or Type 2 diabetes, be at least 18, and be willing to follow study rules and attend follow-up appointments

Medical aspects: you wear a continuous glucose monitor for one month and your glucose data is collected and monitored; the page does not detail device-related risks — ask the study team about side effects and risks before consenting.
Time commitment: one full month of wearing the CGM device plus follow-up appointments (the page does not state how many visits)
Location-specific: follow-up appointments are in person at SMS Clinical Research in Mesquite, TX — no remote option.
Flat $1,000 payment is for taking part in the trial; no partial-participation amount is stated

steps: Go to the official SMS Clinical Research Diabetes Device Study page and review the eligibility criteria
Contact SMS Clinical Research to express interest and confirm the study is currently enrolling
Complete pre-screening to confirm you have Type 1 or Type 2 diabetes and meet the study rules
Attend the enrollment visit in Mesquite, TX and have the CGM device fitted
Wear the continuous glucose monitor for one month as instructed
Receive the $1,000 payment for taking part in the trial
timing: Wear the continuous glucose monitor for one month; attend follow-up appointments during that period (the page does not state the number or dates of appointments).
